recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow correction to the already-applied FHIR-39617 narrative and aligns the notes with the authoritative Endpoint StructureDefinition and examples; no further core source changes were found.
issue_request: FHIR-39617 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and asked PA to clarify how Endpoint.connectionType, Endpoint.payload.type, and Endpoint.payload.mimeType interact across FHIR REST, IHE/XCA document-sharing, and HL7v2-style endpoints, including examples and guidance for the profile fields added by FHIR-39616.
initial_application: The issue had been substantially applied before this reconciliation. Commit 7e0862e5d9b6f369ff12cf0d82d07d14b1c0b5b2 added the Payload Advertising notes section, and commit cf768fcaf240a59e23bc9215108e7c97b5892df0 added the US Core FHIR REST, XCA CCDA, and AU HL7v2 examples. Related FHIR-39616 commits added Endpoint.payload.profileCanonical and Endpoint.payload.profileUri to the Endpoint StructureDefinition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists endpoint=Endpoint and marks Endpoint approved, so the Endpoint notes are current build-scoped source. PA Confluence pages and WGM minutes show the Endpoint Payload project, the FHIR-39617 example review, and the final CCDA example resolution. FHIR-25393 and the linked IHE Zulip thread explain the background distinction between REST/IHE connection types and payload semantics but do not require broader source edits here.
reconciliation: Published a source fix changing the Payload Advertising notes from bare mimeType/connectionType and non-existent Endpoint.profileCanonical/profileUri references to Endpoint.payload.mimeType, Endpoint.connectionType, Endpoint.payload.profileCanonical, and Endpoint.payload.profileUri.
source_changes: source/endpoint/endpoint-notes.xml: clarified the Payload Advertising narrative to cite Endpoint.payload.mimeType, Endpoint.connectionType, Endpoint.payload.profileCanonical, and Endpoint.payload.profileUri, and fixed the malformed profile sentence.
